You are fixing a bug in the Python repository in the current working directory. The bug and the required behavior are described below. Read the relevant source files, make the necessary code edits to the source (do NOT edit the tests), and use the shell to run the tests to confirm your fix. Keep changes minimal.

ISSUE:
DataArray.integrate has a 'dim' arg, but Dataset.integrate has a 'coord' arg
This is just a minor gripe but I think it should be fixed.

The API syntax is inconsistent:
```python
ds.differentiate(coord='x')
da.differentiate(coord='x')
ds.integrate(coord='x')
da.integrate(dim='x')   # why dim??
```
It should definitely be `coord` - IMO it doesn't make sense to integrate or differentiate over a dim because a dim by definition has no information about the distance between grid points. I think because the distinction between dims and coords is one of the things that new users have to learn about, we should be strict to not confuse up the meanings in the documentation/API.

The discussion on the original PR [seems to agree](https://github.com/pydata/xarray/pull/2653#discussion_r246164990), so I think this was just an small oversight.

The only question is whether it requires a deprecation cycle?



The test suite lives in tests/. You can run it with: python -m pytest -q
When the tests pass, you are done.
We need to search for integrate method. Use grep via Bash? But we can use Read with file path and maybe read entire file. Let's just open dataset.py near integrate. Search manually.

We see Dataset.integrate uses coord argument; DataArray.integrate uses dim argument. The issue wants to change DataArray.integrate signature to use coord instead of dim for consistency.

So modify DataArray.integrate method: rename parameter from dim to coord, adjust docstring and internal calls accordingly. Also update any references in code that call integrate on DataArray with dim param. Search.

We need to modify DataArray.integrate signature and internal call. Also update docstring examples maybe but tests likely rely on param name? Let's check tests for integrate usage. Search.

The tests call da.integrate("x") etc. They don't use keyword argument names; they pass positional. So changing signature to coord may break calls if someone uses dim=... but tests likely unaffected. But we need to change DataArray.integrate signature from dim to coord, and adjust internal call to dataset integration accordingly.

Also update docstring examples maybe not needed for tests.

Implement: rename parameter dim to coord; in body, use self._to_temp_dataset().integrate(coord, datetime_unit). Also adjust type hints. Also update any references inside DataArray.integrate that refer to dim variable? Only used in call. So just change signature and internal call.

Also need to update docstring param names: dim -> coord. But not required for tests.
